## Craft



This file provides LLM-friendly entry points to Crafts

## Components

- [Book](https://ahmadsaad.dev/craft/book): A book component for Next.js apps with next-themes and Tailwind CSS, supporting system, light, and dark modes.
- [Game of Life](https://ahmadsaad.dev/craft/game-of-life): A game of life component for Next.js apps with next-themes and Tailwind CSS, supporting system, light, and dark modes.
- [Magical Mouse](https://ahmadsaad.dev/craft/magical-mouse): A magical mouse component for Next.js apps with next-themes and Tailwind CSS, supporting system, light, and dark modes.
- [Modern Progress](https://ahmadsaad.dev/craft/modern-progress): A modern progress component for Next.js apps with next-themes and Tailwind CSS, supporting system, light, and dark modes.
- [Pixel Icon](https://ahmadsaad.dev/craft/pixel-icon): A pixel icon component for Next.js apps with next-themes and Tailwind CSS, supporting system, light, and dark modes.
- [Split Text Effect](https://ahmadsaad.dev/craft/split-text-effect): A split text effect component for Next.js apps with next-themes and Tailwind CSS, supporting system, light, and dark modes.
- [View Magnifier](https://ahmadsaad.dev/craft/view-magnifier): A view magnifier component for Next.js apps with next-themes and Tailwind CSS, supporting system, light, and dark modes.
